versions.changelog: Rewrites onboarding around the user outcome, adds a simple five-step flow, surfaces conditional Receipt launch credit, and models clear user-facing messages. Authorization, spending, replay, security, and eight-tool controls remain unchanged.

Replaces implementation jargon in user-facing copy with connected app, spending allowance, purchase approval, delivery checks, and signed proof. Authentication, security, and purchasing behavior are unchanged.
Adds Receipt-hosted purchase approval and connection allowances with editable daily and per-purchase limits, plus immediate pause and revoke controls.
Updates Receipt MCP to provider-compatible underscore tool names for OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenClaw, and Gumloop.
Adds universal discovery, commercial-boundary triggers, attributed agent referrals, runtime-specific activation, and the owner-authorized First Outcome Credit flow.
Execute clean-profile bootstrap and display the real authorization URL.
Fix clean-machine eligibility and single-attempt OAuth onboarding.
Initial release: native Receipt OAuth MCP commerce for OpenClaw.
